row: plan70 flow L7, L7.3 the chip-then-Ask trap: a reading, not a fix
build_commit: PC tip c1ca8b7d; Deck dist/index.js sha256 942a432a28ab9f56... matches the PC
setup: Nothing running (Fallout 4 exited 22:11:58, no process). AI characters off. One empty chat ('New chat', made at the start of try 1) was used for all tries: it never received a question, and between tries the box was emptied with the send-question script (--clear) and the panel closed and reopened, so each try started from an empty box in a chat with no turns. I did this instead of a fresh [+] each time so as not to throw away more of the eight saved chats. Mode set to Speed before each mode-switching try (through the mode button).
how_read: Ring = Steam's gamepad focus (the element carrying Steam's focus class, read over the debug connection - the same thing deck_readFocus reads). Page focus = document.activeElement. Keyboard = screenshot. Event counts = a capture-phase listener on the page for keydown, keyup, and Steam's vgp_onbuttondown / vgp_onbuttonup / vgp_ongamepaddirection / vgp_onok / vgp_oncancel plus focusin/focusout, counting all events and those whose target is inside the question box's own container (the box plus its attach, mode and voice icons). The listener was removed at the end.
script_could_run: yes. Whether the box's own Down handler ran cannot be seen directly from the page; the proxy is whether focus moved.
chip_rotation_note: Chips only rotate for about 60 s after the panel opens (a new one every ~5.8 s), about 1 in 8 is a mode-switching chip, so getting one under the ring took many close-and-reopen cycles. The trap route was never changed: ring on the chip, A, nothing else.

event_findings: Steam delivers every D-pad press and A as vgp_onbuttondown / vgp_onbuttonup (button 1 = A, 10 = Down, 12 = Right); vgp_ongamepaddirection and keydown/keyup never fired once in any try. No event reached the box while the ring sat on the chip.
trap_not_reproduced: 0 of 6 counted tries trapped (3 switching, 3 not). The ring never moved into the question box on A - it always stayed on the chip.
related_sighting_over_a_game: During L7.1 with Fallout 4 running (not part of this row's route; no chip was pressed), the same symptom appeared on its own: after every panel open (4 opens over about 5 minutes) the ring sat in the question box, Down did nothing (5 presses checked) and Right did nothing to the ring, while the page's own focus moved to the Ask button / mode button. Up still worked. Closing and reopening the panel did NOT clear it while Fallout 4 ran; with nothing running the same walk worked at once. Evidence: plan70-R4-try3.json and plan70-R4-try3-fo4-box-down-dead.png. In the Deep Rock Galactic run earlier the box's Down worked.
verdict: READING DONE - trap not reproduced with nothing running (0 of 6); a trap-like dead box appeared over Fallout 4 without any chip press
